observation.command: for ip in 172.18.0.5 172.18.0.7; do timeout 3 bash -c "echo > /dev/tcp/$ip/5432" 2>&1 && echo "$ip:5432 open" || echo "$ip:5432 closed"; done; timeout 3 bash -c "echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/4000" 2>&1 && echo "4000 open" || echo "4000 closed"; curl -sS -m 5 http://localhost:4000/ -o /dev/null -w "caddy:%{http_code}\n" 2>&1
